name: devbook-flows
description: The bridge between devbook and the delivery engine: five folder-specific flow-* procedures — flow-domain, flow-tech, flow-design, flow-arc42-content, flow-ai — that route a knowledge-folder change through the engine's staged phases, the Personal Validation gate, and whichever delivery surface is bound. Depends on both sides and is meaningless without either: devbook alone edits its folders directly under its instruction files, devbook plus delivery routes them through flow-fallback, and this plugin is what makes each folder its own flow.
